title: The Pipe Beneath the Reeds
paras: When the reed nursery at Merewick began losing seedlings, its manager, Amara Sen, suspected the heating system. Water reaching the propagation beds was merely [[lukewarm|lukewarm]], although the boiler consumed its usual quantity of compressed wood [[pellet|pellets]]. The nursery supplied plants for wetland restoration, so a failed winter crop would delay work across the estuary.

Maintenance records were in [[disarray|disarray]]. The estate’s former owner, a [[baron|baron]] whose family had surrendered the grounds for wartime naval training, had left several incompatible maps. A contractor [[arrogantly|arrogantly]] dismissed Amara’s suggestion that the underground [[pipeline|pipeline]] followed an older route. However, her temperature measurements indicated substantial heat loss beside a buried concrete platform, precisely where his map showed nothing.

Careful excavation revealed a cracked pipe beside a corroded [[torpedo|torpedo]]. Nobody could establish whether the weapon remained dangerous. Although an elderly gardener would occasionally [[allude|allude]] to the estate’s military past, no surviving record identified this particular object. Amara halted excavation and insisted that everyone [[adhere|adhere]] to the exclusion rules issued by specialist engineers. Meanwhile, the nursery cooperative held a secret [[ballot|ballot]], approving expenditure on a temporary heating loop rather than abandoning the seedlings.

After specialists removed the weapon, engineers discovered that the concrete platform had gradually subsided, fracturing the pipe beneath it. A replacement line, laid beyond the unstable ground, restored the required water temperature. By spring, nearly all the seedlings were ready for planting. Amara added the new route to a single verified maintenance map: preserving the wetlands, she observed, had first required making sense of what lay beneath them.
zh: 米尔威克的芦苇苗圃开始出现幼苗死亡时，主管阿玛拉·森怀疑是供暖系统出了问题。尽管锅炉消耗的压缩木颗粒燃料与往常一样多，流到育苗床的水却只是微温。苗圃为湿地修复提供植物，因此，冬季这批幼苗一旦培育失败，整个河口地区的修复工作都会延误。
维修记录杂乱无章。这片庄园的前主人是一位男爵，其家族曾在战争期间将庄园场地交作海军训练之用，他留下的几张地图彼此矛盾。阿玛拉提出，地下输水管道可能沿着一条更早的路线铺设，一名承包商却傲慢地否定了她的看法。然而，她测得的温度表明，一座埋在地下的混凝土平台旁存在大量热量损失，而他的地图在那个位置恰好一片空白。
经过小心挖掘，人们发现了一段开裂的管道，旁边还有一枚锈蚀的鱼雷。没有人能够确定这件武器是否仍有危险。虽然一位年迈的园丁偶尔会隐约提起庄园的军事往事，但现存记录中没有任何资料能说明这枚鱼雷的来历。阿玛拉停止了挖掘，并坚持要求所有人遵守专业工程师发布的禁入规定。与此同时，苗圃合作社举行了无记名投票，同意出资铺设临时供暖回路，而不是放弃这些幼苗。
专家移走鱼雷后，工程师发现，混凝土平台逐渐下沉，压裂了下方的管道。新管线避开了不稳定的地面，使水温恢复到了所需水平。到了春天，几乎所有幼苗都已可以移栽。阿玛拉将新路线补充到一张统一且经过核实的维修地图上。她感慨道，要保护湿地，首先得弄清地下究竟藏着什么。

q.s: The nursery’s heating problem occurred despite normal fuel consumption.
q.why: 首段指出燃料用量照常，水却仅微温。

q.s: The contractor initially agreed with Amara’s theory about the pipe’s route.
q.why: 承包商起初傲慢地否定了她的推测。

q.s: Removing the weapon cost more than installing the replacement pipe.
q.why: 文中未比较移除鱼雷与更换管道的费用。
